name: CNH
recent: Citra Nusa Holdings Berhad 近期持续进行股份回购，并发布了截至2026年6月30日的季度业绩。公司营收环比增长8.9%，但同比下滑17.8%，净利润同比减少53.9%。
notable: 公司于2026年9月多次进行股份回购。
公司发布截至2026年6月30日的季度报告，营收环比增长8.9%，但同比下滑17.8%。
risks: 净利润同比下降53.9%，净利率为3.3%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为13,373,000令吉，环比增长8.9%，同比下滑17.8%；净利润为446,000令吉，净利率3.3%，净利润同比减少53.9%。

recent_en: Citra Nusa Holdings Berhad has been actively conducting share buybacks and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026. Revenue rose 8.9% quarter-on-quarter but fell 17.8% year-on-year, while net profit declined 53.9% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company conducted multiple share buybacks in September 2026.
The company released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 8.9% QoQ but down 17.8% YoY.
risks_en: Net profit declined 53.9% year-on-year, with a net margin of 3.3%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 13,373,000, up 8.9% QoQ but down 17.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 446,000 with a net margin of 3.3%, down 53.9% YoY.
